Prostaglandins are widely used for the termination of pregnancy (p.2004) and misoprostol has been studied both for cervical preparation and for inducing uter- ine contractions. In the first trimester, misoprostol is used for cervical ripening be- fore surgical termination; it has been reported to be effective when given orally, sublingually, or vaginally,1-4 usually in a dose of 400 micrograms.
